1 (Currently amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a compliant seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw, wherein the tapered fluid conduit is distinct from any other tapered fluid conduit described in the prior art.

3 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than 0.030 inches, wherein the tapered fluid conduit is distinct from any other tapered fluid conduit described in the prior art.

7 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered fluid conduit is distinct from any other tapered fluid conduit described in the prior art.

9 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal, and wherein the compliant seal is distinct from any other compliant seal described in the prior art.

10 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, further comprising a seal retainer that is removable to allow for removal and replacement of the compliant seal, wherein the seal retainer is distinct from any other seal retainer described in the prior art.

11 (Currently amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the compliant seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to 20,000 psi, and wherein the tapered fluid conduit is distinct from any other tapered fluid conduit described in the prior art.
